sub_answers.text: The club was part of the Tasmanian Football League from the early 1900s until 2001.[d8767658s0p0] The club joined the Southern Football League in 2001 and is currently competing in the Southern Football League Premier Division.[d8767658s0p0] North Hobart was invited into the statewide Tasmanian league in 2009 and remained there until 2013.[d8767658s0p0] The club returned to the Tasmanian State League in 2018 and, after the TSL ceased in 2024, rejoined the Southern Football League in 2025.[d8767658s0p0]

sub_answers.text: In 2014 North Hobart Football Club Inc. changed from an incorporated body to a company limited which took 100% ownership of the Hobart City Football Club and adopted the Hobart City Demons as its trading name [d8767658s0p0]. On 9 October 2017 the paying members of the Hobart City Demons voted 371-118 in favour of returning the playing name of the club to the North Hobart identity for the 2018 season and beyond [d8767658s0p0].

sub_answers.text: The club was part of the Tasmanian Football League from the early 1900s until 2001 [d8767658s0p0]. The club joined the Southern Football League in 2001 and competed there after leaving the TFL [d8767658s0p0]. In 2009 North Hobart was invited into the second reincarnation of the statewide Tasmanian league and remained there from 2009 until 2013 [d8767658s0p0]. North Hobart returned to the Tasmanian State League in 2018 and remained in that competition until the TSL ceased in 2024 [d8767658s0p0]. Following the cessation of the TSL in 2024, the club rejoined the Southern Football League in 2025 and is currently competing in the Southern Football League Premier Division [d8767658s0p0].

sub_answers.text: North Hobart has won twelve Tasmanian State Premierships in the years 1914, 1920, 1923, 1929, 1936, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1945, 1961, 1962 and 1969 [d8767658s1p0]. The club was the first club inducted into the AFL Tasmania Hall of Fame as a Great Club in 2005 [d8767658s0p0].
